stem: What lesson does the narrator learn while spending time with her grandmother?

options.label: A
options.text: Mysteries in nature usually have complex explanations.

options.label: B
options.text: Spending time outdoors helps a person maintain good health.

options.label: C
options.text: People who wake up early have more time to participate in daily activities.

options.label: D
options.text: Ordinary events can be explained in imaginative ways.
